4.4.1
Authentication Module
The authentication module provides:
• User Registration
• Secure Login
• Password Hashing
• JWT Token Generation
• Session Management
4.4.2
Workspace Module
Each authenticated user owns one or more workspaces.
Each workspace stores:
• Uploaded Documents
• Generated Embeddings
• FAISS Index
• Chat History
4.4.3
Document Processing Module
The document processing module performs:
• PDF Processing
• DOCX Processing
• TXT Processing
• Metadata Extraction
• Page Extraction
